# Tangle Docs

Tangle Docs explain how to run coding agents in Tangle Sandbox, call models through Tangle Router, and use one Tangle account, key and balance for both.

## Core pages

- Sandbox quickstart: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/quickstart
- Sandbox overview: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/overview
- TypeScript SDK: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript
- Python: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python
- CLI: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli
- Start a cloud agent: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents
- Run the same agent on E2B or Daytona: https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/other-providers
- Router: https://docs.tangle.tools/gateway
- Router quickstart: https://docs.tangle.tools/gateway/getting-started
- Platform account and keys: https://docs.tangle.tools/platform
- Release notes: https://docs.tangle.tools/release-notes
- Benchmarks: https://tangle.tools/benchmarks

## Agent guidance

- Use the docs setup skill at https://docs.tangle.tools/agent-setup.md.
- Use the Tangle product manifest at https://tangle.tools/.well-known/tangle-agent.json.
- Use Router OpenAPI at https://router.tangle.tools/openapi.json for model-routing calls.
- Install scoped packages only: `@tangle-network/sandbox` and `@tangle-network/tcloud` from npm, `tangle-sandbox` from PyPI.
- Use `TANGLE_API_KEY` for authenticated calls.
